correctness.rationale: For every x, set g_k=T^k|x| and F_x=closure of the ideal generated by the g_k. The norm-convergent sum e_x=Σ2^(-k-1)g_k/(1+||g_k||) dominates each generator, hence is quasi-interior in F_x. Positive T preserves F_x (ideal domination), and boundedness extends invariance to the closure. A_n(F_x)⊂F_x, so norm mean-ergodicity implies P(F_x)⊂F_x. Closed ideals inherit the order-continuous lattice norm. Dobrick’s weak-unit positive mean-ergodic result applies to restricted T and g_0=x, while the Gao–Troitsky–Xanthos regular-sublattice equivalence transfers uo convergence from F_x to E. All x including zero; no claim of ambient order convergence. The independent proof reconstruction uses an externally stated theorem, not a finite diagnostic.
